name: WXETA
summary: The WXETA facet initializer checks initialized but never sets it. A caller can repeatedly overwrite the token owner, authorize itself and raise the mint cap, then use the authorization-protected mint to create tokens and drain paired assets.

loss.notes: Lower bound from the anchor transaction only: minted WXETA is exchanged for 49847.502413020099894895 BUSD from pair 0xf5a32e5e54a771b9d3c853143db74449b721c03b, leaving 1 BUSD. BUSD is valued at par. The trace shows no attacker-supplied paired asset. Subsequent conversion to WBNB and builder payment are not additional loss or deductions. Later initializer/mint transactions remain unaccounted for; the imported $110000 total is unsupported.

ageReset.description: DiamondCut adds the token facet and its initialize(uint256) and mint(address,uint256) selectors; initialization target is zero.

limitations: Earlier silent internal initializer calls and mutable fallback history are not exhaustively covered; latest causal state and earliest exploit remain provisional.

sources.note: Fresh receipt and callTracer reproduce initialize and mint delegated to facet 0x7c83dc9221cfd48ac760710b7f1cd7b76ff6fcc2. Its pre-exploit runtime hash matches codeArtifact. DiamondCut history has only deployment and activation cuts before the anchor; activation is log 97, with facet address in data word 5. Deployment is tx 0x4918a84beee1a64931656b55c2697cb46e218f339cc1babda7df090b4d6f3e77, block 36918555. These bounded checks do not establish complete state history.

Partial review only. Explorer verified source at https://bscscan.com/address/0x7c83dc9221cfd48ac760710b7f1cd7b76ff6fcc2#code shows initialize never sets initialized and mint requires authorized[msg.sender]. Anchor callTracer and receipt show 1e33 raw WXETA minted directly to the pair and 49847502413020099894895 raw BUSD transferred out; getReserves at blocks 42284161/42284162 reproduces the depletion and 1 BUSD remainder. Explorer token history through its last transfer at block 63374178 contains 6098 events; all 306 mint-emitting transaction traces were checked. Only the anchor also initializes within a mint transaction. Direct history reveals later separate successful initializers in source-7. Earlier zero-value internal initializers are not excluded: account txlistinternal returns no entries and initialize emits no event. Later campaign losses and mutable diamond fallback history remain unresolved.

limitations: Earliest silent initializer takeover remains unresolved.
Later initializer/mint campaigns require loss accounting; only an anchor-transaction lower bound is established.
